title: M2A Node Capability Registry Entry
description: Registration contract for any node (agent, MCP server, runtime, specialist) that wants to receive M2A broadcasts. Each node self-registers on startup; middleware uses this to evaluate broadcast eligibility and suppress irrelevant responders.

node_id.description: Globally unique node identifier (recommended: kebab-case, e.g. 'telemetry-zone-01')

node_type.description: Structural type of the node in the swarm fabric

pillar.description: Pillar membership — determines which pillar-scoped broadcasts this node receives

capabilities.description: List of capability tokens this node can satisfy. Middleware matches these against request_filter.required_capabilities.

domains.description: Semantic domains this node operates in. Used for domain-match routing.

latency_class.description: Node's self-declared response latency class. Middleware uses this to filter realtime broadcasts.

priority.description: Static priority weight (1=lowest, 100=highest). Used as tiebreaker in rank scoring.

max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum simultaneous M2A requests this node can handle. Middleware backs off when exceeded.

health.description: Live health state, updated by the node on heartbeat (every 30s)

load_pct.description: Current load percentage. Middleware reduces routing weight above 80%.

version.description: Semantic version of this node's capability contract (semver)

endpoint.description: Optional network endpoint for direct reply routing

cooling_metadata.description: Optional cooling-system-specific metadata for xAI Colossus thermal nodes

zone_ids.description: Thermal zones this node has authority over (e.g. ['zone-01', 'zone-02'])

thermal_load_mw.description: Thermal load (MW) this node monitors. Reference: 48 zones x 25 MW = 1,200 MW total.

sensor_count.description: Number of physical sensors feeding this node (feeds digital twin 3,400+ sensor count)
